diffs.unified:
--- a/models/marts/semantic/metrics.yml
+++ b/models/marts/semantic/metrics.yml
@@ -105,3 +105,40 @@
       measure: signal_value_measure
     filter: |
       {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'google_trends'
+
+  - name: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts
+    label: Bluesky GTA day-off posts
+    description: Bluesky posts per UTC day that say someone is taking time off and also mention GTA. A count of posts, not of days off taken.
+    type: simple
+    type_params:
+      measure: signal_value_measure
+    filter: |
+      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off_gta' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'bluesky'
+
+  - name: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_2026
+    label: Bluesky GTA day-off posts, 2026
+    description: Bluesky GTA day-off posts in the 2026 study window (release Thu 19 Nov 2026).
+    type: simple
+    type_params:
+      measure: signal_value_measure
+    filter: |
+      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off_gta' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'bluesky' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__study_year') }} = 2026
+
+  - name: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_2025
+    label: Bluesky GTA day-off posts, 2025 control
+    description: Bluesky GTA day-off posts in the 2025 control window (aligned on Thu 20 Nov 2025).
+    type: simple
+    type_params:
+      measure: signal_value_measure
+    filter: |
+      {{ Dimension('signal_day__signal') }} = 'posts:day_off_gta' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__source') }} = 'bluesky' and {{ Dimension('signal_day__study_year') }} = 2025
+
+  - name: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_yoy
+    label: Bluesky GTA day-off posts, year over year
+    description: 2026 Bluesky GTA day-off posts over 2025 posts on the same days from release (x times). Always filter signal_day__days_from_release to days both years have loaded; a single day with zero 2025 posts reads NULL. Posts, not days off; association, not causation.
+    type: derived
+    type_params:
+      expr: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_2026 / nullif(bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_2025, 0)
+      metrics:
+        - name: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_2026
+        - name: bluesky_gta_day_off_posts_2025
